turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Past questions talk about finished actions, so first we need the past form of the verb.
Look: Today I paint. Yesterday I painted. Use -ed after a regular verb to talk about a finished action.
Right: Tom walked to the shop. Wrong: Tom walk to the shop yesterday.
Now you try. Write the verb: Yesterday I (clean) my room.
